title: 2048 AI
description: Watch an AI solve 2048 and experiment with its algorithms and speed.
about:
2048 AI is a browser game where you watch the AI combine matching numbered tiles. Change its algorithm and speed from the controls, or play with the arrow keys.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Watch the AI combine matching numbered tiles. Change its algorithm and speed from the controls, or play with the arrow keys.
tips: Use arrow keys to move tiles manually.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play 2048 AI?
faq.answer: Watch the AI combine matching numbered tiles. Change its algorithm and speed from the controls, or play with the arrow keys.

faq.question: Can I play 2048 AI in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
